description: Q6_K FFN-down four-warp fp16 geometry promotion record (nv-q6-ffn-down-four-warp-fp16-microgate-20260815.md; nv-q6k-ffn-down-four-warp-fp16-promotion-scope-20260816.md). Device time 25.7 us vs 31.0 us control on this node (below llama 28.75 us); reverse wall bracket after the capture-safe prune fix (dbc1fdee3) is -39.0 us/token (+0.79%), token-exact across control A/candidate/control C. The candidate swaps the installed row_tile-2 coop Q6 FFN-down consumer for a 128-thread four-warp fp16 direct consumer with the same Q6 dequant arithmetic, no Q8 provider, and the M2b residual add absorbed in-kernel. The route additionally requires the M2b ffn-down resadd promotion and is ANDed with it at resolve time.
